words.name: lint-element-free-techniques
words.decision_reason: Vọng Triều Đường is an R3 no-lean sect whose 3 lineage techniques (lamp-ward-seal-canon, tide-reading-gaze, last-lamp-vigil) run on no element (names: [] in vong_trieu.techniques.json). The temporary names: ["thuy", "tho"] lint proxy causes CongPhap.usable() (src/gameplay/cultivation/cong_phap.gd:42-46) to return false for 5 of 10 living holders (kien_muc_hai, tram_chau_nhi, ve_lu_sinh, dinh_vong_tinh, ky_lam_sa) who lack Water or Earth, stripping their main/secret methods in season_tick() and FighterCompiler. Also requires CongPhap.tech_one() / bonus_lines() to handle names.is_empty() without returning 0.0 purity from LinhCan.average_purity([]).
words.spec: Allow names: [] on origin=='authored' (or catalogue-sect-*) main/secret techniques in tools/design/arts/lint_techniques.py when all carried arts have element == '', handle names.is_empty() in CongPhap (e.g. strongest_element purity or body-like scaling instead of 0.0) and export_techniques.py, then restore names: [] on lamp-ward-seal-canon, tide-reading-gaze, and last-lamp-vigil (plus xuyen_lam and thu_phan peers in b02).
words.gdd_text: Cultivation Techniques rule 8: element-free authored methods (names: []) are usable by any spiritual root.
